$comment: Assumptions of the account value estimator (/tools/account-value), written by hand: see docs/editorial-data.md. Every figure here is indicative and shown as such on the page. Shop skins are costed from the synced shop prices; only the tiers obtained through draws or passes, which have no shop price, take a cost from drawCost. Exchange rates are units of each currency for one US dollar, read on ratesDate.
usdPerDiamondNote: 257 diamonds for 4.99 USD, the usual top-up pack without first-purchase bonus.
ratesNote: EUR, IDR and MYR derived from the UK consular rates of November 2026 (per pound, divided by the dollar rate); PHP from a public market mid-rate, rounded.
